name: Raise Island
prerequisites: born of the bones of the earth or restless as the tide
text:
Frequency once per hour

---
You churn the sea and fish up stone so your enemies together can receive their punishment. Each enemy in a 30-foot emanation must succeed at a Fortitude save save against your class DC or be swept up to 15 feet to another location of your choice within the affected area and become Off-Guard until the start of your next turn. Then, if you're on a surface, a pillar of earth rises underneath you and lasts for 1 minute. The pillar is 10 feet tall, and its surface includes your space and a 5-foot emanation around you. After the pillar rises, you can attempt a melee Strike against one enemy in reach.
